## Install

1. Download the zip below and unzip it.
2. Move `wharfkeep.app` to `/Applications`.
3. The app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. If macOS blocks it, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/wharfkeep.app`.

Requires Apple Silicon and [Colima](https://github.com/abiosoft/colima).
